sent_subject: Three Oaks Books: quick 502 fix, then 3 homepage wins
sent:
Ruth —

I tried to review your site just now: threeoaksbooks.co.uk is returning a 502 (Bad Gateway). Until hosting/DNS is fixed, online conversion is effectively zero. Ask your host/CDN to resolve the upstream error; once it’s up, here are three homepage changes worth doing first:

1) Search-first hero that sells. Replace the hero with a “Find your next book” search bar and three chips: Bestsellers, New & Noteworthy, BookTok Now. Instant results dropdown; no carousel. It cuts the time from landing to a relevant book.

2) Homepage cards built to decide quickly. On every book card: cover, title, author, price, format pill (HB/PB), and one primary action (“Quick add” or “See details”). If you have ratings, surface stars. On mobile, make cards 2‑up so 4–6 options are visible above the fold.

3) The promise line above the fold. One line that spells out delivery cost/threshold, delivery timing, and returns—visible on desktop without scrolling, and directly under search on mobile. This removes the two biggest abandon causes for books: “How much and how soon?”

Timely conversion notes for a bookshop:
- BookTok is still moving books in the UK (c. £175m in 2025; BBC). Add a “BookTok Now” shelf on the homepage that links to a simple landing page you update weekly.
- AI-assisted shoppers are converting ~20% better and staying longer (Retail Gazette, Sept). Make product and list pages easy for assistants to parse: add schema.org Book data (ISBN, author, price, availability, rating), and a one‑sentence “who this is for” on each title.
- UK retail footfall fell 2.9% YoY in September (BRC). Expect more online browsing into Q4; publish delivery cut‑off dates and gift options early. If you offer gift wrap or preorders, surface them in the first screen.

Optional, if you’re on Shopify: Canvas (launched this month) lets you ship the search‑first hero and “BookTok Now” section without a developer.

If the 502 is resolved today, I can do a fast, specific tear‑down with screenshots next.

Fieldwork Studio
